format: NDCA amateur age categories (Pre-Teen, Junior, Youth, Under 21, Adult, Senior I-IV)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Age classifications take effect on the competitor's birthday, with a 60-day window (30 days either side) to move up, extended for multi-day events; Under 21 has no grace period. Youth runs from the 16th to the 18th birthday and Adult starts at the 19th. Senior I-IV each need one partner at the higher and the other at the lower threshold (35/30, 45/40, 55/50, 65/60).

requirement: Competition OS does not calculate or verify this age rule. For initial activation the organizer verifies age-division eligibility and the decision is recorded (who, when, outcome, reason code). Age-restricted divisions cannot be confirmed for scheduling without that determination; a waiver never clears them.

tests.name: a waiver never clears an age-restricted entry
refuses a waiver on an age-restricted division, a wrong reason, and a missing reason

enforcement_point: Organizer action updateCompetitionEntryEligibilityAction; operational gate in heat generation, floor planning and readiness counts. No automated age calculation exists.
interpretation_notes: OD-03 Option C (2026-11-23): organizer verification now, automated per-body calculation in a later separately reviewed phase. NDCA's Adult starts at the 19th birthday, so an 18-year-old is NDCA Youth, not Adult; the OD-02 restriction (18 or older) is a DanceFlow policy and does not map onto NDCA categories. Whose age counts for a couple is a separate NDCA rule (X.A.6, p43, in the audit inventory) and was not re-read for this entry.
